children: NorthStrive announced that holders of its units may separately trade Class A ordinary shares, rights and warrants starting Sept. 2, 2026.
Units from the IPO can be separated beginning Sept. 2, 2026, allowing individual trading of components.
Class A ordinary shares, rights and warrants expected to trade on Nasdaq as NSAI, NSAIR and NSAIW.
Units remaining intact will continue to trade on Nasdaq under NSAIU.
No fractional rights or warrants will be issued; only whole rights and warrants will trade.
